== Kobiton MCP server: per-skill environment rules

*Highlights*

- The Kobiton MCP server now declares and enforces per-skill host/platform/file-access rules. Skills that don't meet a caller's environment surface a clear rejection instead of silently mis-executing.
- This matters because the MCP server runs across hosts with different capabilities (local file access, streamed watch/monitor affordance, macOS/Apple Silicon, etc.). A skill that needs a local binary or local file access will now say so up front instead of failing opaquely on a host that can't provide it.

== Device passcode

- Fixed the Portal not populating the passcode config in `DeviceConfiguration` on the initial device connection. Passcode is now applied on first connection.

== Scriptless Test Runs

- For Test Cases converted from automation sessions, the Test Run Overview now labels each Test Step with the underlying automation action when Revisit is active — for example `/click`, `/back`, or `/orientation`. At conversion time the Test Steps still display human-friendly labels (`Tap`, `Press Back`, `Install`); during Revisit they switch to the forward-slash-prefixed Appium endpoint, which matches how the step is referenced in the automation script. This makes it easier to trace each Revisit step back to its source command.
